toolchain: GCC 4.0.4, 4.1.0 and 4.0.2 (pspdev Allegrex patch; GCC 4.0.4 and 4.0.2 with this project's measured Allegrex changes)
psp-gcc 1.7.1 and SN Systems SNC 1.2.7503 (decomp.me PSP compiler kits)
approach: Strict matching decompilation: a function counts only when its compiled and linked bytes equal the original exactly, with nothing masked.

notes: Work in progress on the main game program.
